ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. Rule.
Mr. Krutik Parikh, learned AGP waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.
With the consent of learned advocates for the respective parties, the matter is taken up for final hearing today.
2. It is the case of the petitioner that a parcel of land belonging to the petitioner came to be acquired by the respondent authority.

An award was declared against NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/11938/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/07/2023 undefined which a reference was made in the Punjabhai Mohanbhai Virani vs State Of Gujarat on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67606117/
1 court of learned 9th Additional Sr. Civil Judge, Jamnagar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Such reference came to be allowed in part by award dated 22.7.2022.

Subsequent thereto, the petitioner filed an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act (for short 'the Act') requesting to grant the amount which has been awarded qua other land owners whose references came to be partly allowed and whose lands were acquired under the same said notification and amount was decided by the Collector by a common award.
It is the case of the petitioner that the application came to be rejected by respondent no. 2 only on the ground that the GIDC for which land was acquired had decided to file appeal.

Hence,
this petition.

3. Mr. K.M. Sheth, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner would submit that the authority concerned should not have rejected the application filed under Section 28A of the Act in view of the fact that no appeal has been preferred by GIDC till date.
Even otherwise, the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/11938/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/07/2023 undefined authorities should have kept the application pending for its decision even if the appeal is filed.
He therefore would submit that the petition be allowed and the order impugned be quashed and set aside.
4. Mr. Krutik Parikh, learned AGP appearing for the respondent State has opposed this petition.
5. We have heard Mr. K.M. Sheth, learned advocate for the petitioner and Mr. Kritik Parikh, learned AGP appearing for the respondent State.
It is undisputed fact that land belonging to the petitioner was acquired for GIDC for which award was passed.

Some of the land owners whose lands were acquired by the award filed reference under Section 18 of the Act which was finally decided by the learned 9th Additional Sr. Civil Judge, Jamnagar vide judgment and order dated 22.07.2022.

Since the petitioner had not filed any reference, having come to know that, he filed an application under Section 28A of the Act and by the impugned order rejected the application only on the ground that GIDC has decided to NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/11938/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/07/2023 undefined file.
In our considered opinion, the order is contrary to law.
The authority should not have rejected the application only on the ground that the GIDC is contemplating to file appeal.
The respondent should have kept the application alive till the amount of compensation is finally decided.
6. Hence, we allow the present petition.
The impugned order is hereby quashed and set aside.
The application filed by the present petitioner under Section 28A of the Act is hereby revived.
The application shall be decided only after the final outcome of the reference proceedings.
Rule is made absolute.
No costs.
